title: EAORCS Master Standards & Schema Registry Catalog
description: Master schema index cataloging OSAP v1.1, W3C DID, audit attestation, certification, and trust graph schemas for EAORCS Phase 10.

osap-v1.1.name: Open Software Assurance Passport v1.1 Specification
osap-v1.1.description: Formal JSON Schema defining structure, metadata, evidence manifests, and cryptographic proofs for OSAP v1.1.

did-eaorcs-v1.name: EAORCS Sovereign Identity Node W3C DID Schema v1.0
did-eaorcs-v1.description: W3C Decentralized Identifier (DID) v1.0 Document Schema for EAORCS Sovereign Nodes.

audit-attestation-v1.name: EAORCS Audit Attestation Record Schema v1.0
audit-attestation-v1.description: Schema defining cryptographically verifiable audit trail records and compliance attestations.

certification-v1.name: EAORCS ISO/IEC 25010 & Security Certification Schema v1.0
certification-v1.description: Schema for platform qualification and ISO/IEC 25010 quality assurance certificates.

osap-core-v2.name: Open Software Assurance Passport Core v2
osap-core-v2.description: OSAP Core v2 multi-tier lineage and risk evaluation schema.

trust-graph-v1.name: EAORCS Trust Graph Model Schema v1.0
trust-graph-v1.description: Schema representing enterprise trust graphs, node relationships, and attestation flows.
